import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (text numbers) and drop rows with conversion errors
    df = df.copy()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Clean sex label variants (trim spaces)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip() if df['sex'].notna().all() else df['sex']
    # Remove rows with out-of-range values (flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g)
    valid = (
        (df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235) &
        (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)
    )
    df = df[valid]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Compute average body mass per species
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
